subject: Connecting SQL server with FreeTDS drive failed on Shinyapps.io

messages.author: b2b2b752fe3de41b
messages.subject: Connecting SQL server with FreeTDS drive failed on Shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi,

I have been using FreeTDS drive for my applications involving sql server when deployed on Shinyapps.io. 

My PC is on Windows, so usually I switch "{SQL Server}" in my connection string to "FreeTDS" before publishing to shinyapps.io.

Recently, I started to get error messages below and the connection fails:
RODBC] ERROR: state IM002, code 0, message [unixODBC][Driver Manager]Data source name not found, and no default driver specified
My SQL server databases are hosted on a Amazon virtual machine. 

It would be great if anyone knows what's the solution for this.

Thanks,
Allen

messages.author: b2b2b752fe3de41b
messages.subject: Re: Connecting SQL server with FreeTDS drive failed on Shinyapps.io
parts:
Sorry about this.
It seems that this only happens when I deploy with one of laptop(windows 10 64bit) but not the other (windows 7 32 bit). 
When I deploy the app with the windows 7 laptop, everything works out fine.


Thanks again!
Allen

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Connecting SQL server with FreeTDS drive failed on Shinyapps.io
parts:
Allen,

Its best to use the following format for your ODBC connection string:

odbcDriverConnect("driver=FreeTDS;Server=hostname;database=dbname;uid=username;pwd=password")

Replacing the values with the ones for your server. This is because on shinyapps.io there is no system wide DSNs configured.

-Andy
